Biologics License Application: In late 2024, we completed our submission of a BLA to the FDA seeking approval of Deramiocel for the treatment of DMD.
The FDA accepted the BLA for review, granted Priority Review, and assigned a PDUFA target action date of August 31, 2025.
We subsequently submitted our response to the CRL, which the FDA accepted as a complete response and classified as a Class 2 resubmission, assigning a new PDUFA target action date of August 22, 2026.

Advisory Committee Meeting: On July 29, 2026, the FDA held a meeting of the Cellular, Tissue and Gene Therapies Advisory Committee (the “Ad-Com Committee”) where the Ad-Com Committee heard the respective positions of the FDA and the Company with respect to the data presented to the FDA.
The FDA classified the submission as a major amendment and extended the PDUFA target action date by three months, to November 22, 2026.
The FDA also extended the PDUFA target action date to November 22, 2026.
Our BLA for Deramiocel remains under FDA review, with a PDUFA target action date of November 22, 2026.
